kernel: fused bf16 -> saturating e4m3 MLA context K/V pack (one HBM pass); two backends: 'specialized' (hand-written, one warp per token, 12-head unrolled variant) and 'cake' (one generated program per head group)
note: Dispatch surface shared by both fused backends; every call outside it takes the composable torch path (same numerics on torch >= 2.13). backend='auto' takes the specialized kernel for the head counts in auto_specialized_num_heads (12 = Kimi-K3 96 heads / TP8, where it measured 0-3% faster than the Cake program on GB300/B200 at every token count) and the Cake programs otherwise (1.03-1.4x faster for every other head count), trying the other backend when the preferred one cannot serve the call. The Cake backend is one generated program per head group (consecutive head pairs a warp owns: 1, 2, 3 or 4), selected on the host from (num_tokens, num_heads) by flashinfer.mla_kv_pack._plan_head_group and built for the exact compute capabilities 10.0 (sm_100a) and 10.3 (sm_103a); the specialized backend is compiled for every compute capability >= 10.0. Token and head counts are runtime kernel arguments on both, so nothing is compiled per shape. num_tokens covers the captured chunked-prefill rows (1..66048 in serving; 1..131072 validated); measured_num_tokens / measured_num_heads are the rows of the performance contracts. Head geometry is fixed (DeepSeek/Kimi MLA).
